summary: PR-001 is resolved. Deadline-related worker exit or EOF now proceeds through timeout release and cleanup verification; abnormal early closure still fails. The deterministic regression covers both closure paths and preserves cleanup failures. No remaining blockers to opening the draft PR.
checks: Reviewed the complete runtime/test delta and surrounding hold-release and cleanup-verification code.
Confirmed expired holds retain timeout classification without treating channel closure as proof of successful cleanup.
Confirmed missing exit records, cancellation, unacceptable exit codes and cleanup errors still fail verification.
Reviewed the six-case subprocess regression covering rehearsal and target-error holds, poll/receive closure, and watchdog-killed cleanup.
Inspected the preserved pre-fix transcript showing all six regression cases failed and the supplied full-suite transcript showing 59 tests passed with zero skips.
Confirmed production deadlines remain unchanged and the earlier fixture startup repair remains narrowly scoped.
Checked that PR claims retain the pending hardware-rehearsal limitation and accurately disclose deferred HOLD-IMPL-007.
limitations: This re-review used read-only local source, Git and evidence inspection; no tests, hardware access, GUI attachment or network calls were performed.
Test results were inspected as supplied evidence, not independently rerun.
Hardware hold rehearsal, GUI/SSH compatibility and actual issue-205 reproduction remain unvalidated. This verdict concerns draft-PR readiness.
